deleteMessage: This permanently removes the selected {noun}. Items in use can't be deleted and will be skipped.
activateMessage: The selected {noun} will be marked active.
deactivateMessage: The selected {noun} will be marked inactive and won't appear in pickers for new records.
addTagsSubtitle: These tags will be added to the {count} selected {noun}. Existing tags are kept.
tagsDeleteMessage: This permanently deletes the selected tags (and all their values) and detaches them from any products using them. This cannot be undone.
